the reduction functor on formal algebraic spaces and its etale-local behaviour (Formal Spaces, Lemmas formal-spaces-lemma-reduction-formal-algebraic-space and formal-spaces-lemma-reduction-smooth, Example formal-spaces-example-reduction-affine-formal-spectrum)
local finite type of morphisms of algebraic spaces is etale local on source and target (Morphisms of Spaces, Section spaces-morphisms-section-finite-type)
core_obligations: Prove the equivalence of: (1) the property of lemma-finite-type-red holds for all affine etale-local pieces U -> V of f; (2) it holds on some covering {Y_j -> Y} with pieces X_{ji} -> Y_j; (3) it holds on a covering {X_i -> X} with factorizations X_i -> Y_i -> Y; (4) the morphism of reductions f_red : X_red -> Y_red is locally of finite type
proof_roadmap: The equivalence of (1), (2) and (3) is the general correspondence between arrow properties and morphism properties applied to the property of lemma-finite-type-red.

For a covering as in (2), the reductions {Y_{j,red} -> Y_red} and {X_{ji,red} -> X_red} are etale coverings by affine schemes, and X_{ji,red} -> Y_{j,red} corresponds to the quotient ring map B_j/b_j -> A_{ji}/a_{ji} by the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements.

Hence X_{ji,red} -> Y_{j,red} is locally of finite type exactly when B_j -> A_{ji} has the property of lemma-finite-type-red, and since local finite type is etale local on source and target this gives the equivalence of (2) and (4).
difficulty_reason: H3: a four-way equivalence assembled from the formal-spaces property-transfer lemma and the explicit ring description of the reduction of an affine formal spectrum.
